quick.title: Fix gray-matter import error in festinalente.cjs
quick.problem: gray-matter import failing in bundled script - TypeError: import_gray_matter is not a function

finding.reason: Contains gray-matter import that causes bundling issue

quick.approach: Change gray-matter import from namespace import to default import. The namespace import creates a module object but gray-matter exports a function as default.

constraints.constraint: Only change the import style, no other refactoring
Must rebuild CLI and copy to .festinalente/scripts/

verify.step: Run: node .festinalente/scripts/festinalente.cjs search-engineering task completion persistence
Expect: JSON output with search results (no TypeError)

commit.message: quick(004): Fix gray-matter import error in festinalente.cjs

quick.summary: Changed gray-matter import from namespace import (import * as matter) to default import (import matter) in yaml-parser.computer.ts. The bundler was wrapping the namespace import as a module object, but the code expected a callable function.
